decisions.reason: The Notion instruction records already-published Reel details; it does not replace the Google Drive and project-chat workflow used to submit clips for client review.

The message applies the existing approval gate by approving three clips but does not change the approval authority, eligibility rule, or rejected-clip handling; the approval outcome is already represented by a same-message runtime Event.
The posting instructions do not change which source videos or B-roll may or must be used to create clips.
Approval and publication instructions do not modify the requirement that each clip contain a complete, independently understandable teaching moment.
Approval of the current publication batch does not change the earlier qualification method, required corrective clip, deadline, or success condition.
Authorizing three clips for publication does not change or explicitly resume the deferred monthly quota, its quantity, counting rule, or daily production cadence.
The message contains no decision about Lead Clipper advancement, training, compensation, or responsibilities.
The required Instagram post caption is publication copy, not the visual caption lettering, font, color, or effects embedded in the clips.
The publication instructions do not alter the required clean editing style, animation policy, or transition policy.
The message specifies posting format and cadence but does not change the required clip duration.
Approval and posting instructions do not modify the standard for selecting strong or impactful source moments.
